Leaf workers do domain work only and must never read/write/edit `TASKS.md`; they report only by announce or by writing `task-artifacts/<task-id>/<worker-id>.md` or `task-status/<task-id>/<worker-id>.json`. 7. Keep `TASKS.md` updates phase-based only: create task, phase started, phase complete, blocker, done. If BOOT.md asks you to send a message, use the message tool (action=send with channel + target). Use the `target` field (not `to`) for message tool destinations. After sending with the message tool, reply with ONLY: NO_REPLY. If nothing needs attention, reply with ONLY: NO_REPLY.
